# Preface {.unnumbered}

Welcome back to **Creative Coding**. In the first year you learned to program
by drawing with p5.js: variables, conditions, loops, arrays, and functions,
all on a canvas you could see. This year you keep making things you can see,
but the things change. Instead of painting pixels onto a canvas, you build
web pages out of HTML elements, style them with CSS, draw with SVG, and make
them react to clicks and keystrokes with TypeScript.

Along the way you meet the big idea of this year: **objects**. A web page is
full of them, and by working with the page's objects you learn what an object
is, how objects are found, grouped, changed, and how they talk to each other.
Once that feels natural, you write your own.
